default_lines.note: Used by every service point without its own extracted set (kanto_pewter_museum, hoenn_rustboro_devon, sinnoh_oreburgh_museum, unova_nacrene_museum, kalos_ambrette_fossil_lab, galar_route6_restoration). ALL placeholder text.

note: Dialogue lines for the fossil-revival service points, keyed by the flow steps and refusal reasons PUWFossilRevivalService returns. EVERY line carries a status: 'extracted' lines are staged game text quoted from a held source (named per line); 'placeholder' lines were written for PUW and are NOT extracted game text - they exist so the NPC interaction has words at bind time and must be replaced or approved as PUW-original writing, never cited as game text. Substitution tokens follow the source games' own convention: {PLAYER} = player name, {SPECIES} = revived species display name, {FOSSIL} = fossil item display name (in the extracted FRLG lines these are the game's {STR_VAR_1} = species and {STR_VAR_2} = fossil item, renamed here for readability; the wording is otherwise verbatim). In the extracted lines, the source's paragraph-break control code is rendered as a line break.

back_to_life.text:
You late.
Where were you?
Your fossil is back to life!
It was {SPECIES} like I think!

greeting_ask.text:
Hiya!
I am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.
Here, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.
You!
Have you a fossil for me?

handed_over.text:
So!
You hurry and give me that!
{PLAYER} handed over the
{FOSSIL} to the weird doctor.

identify.text:
Oh!
That is {FOSSIL}, it is!
It is fossil of {SPECIES},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!
My Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!

wait.text:
I take a little time!
You go for walk a little while!
